spans.s:
Hospitable,Ⓒa.ⒹAtiTeya (yI f.), satkAra-SIla, atiTipUjaka, AtiTyakArin.
ⓃHospitably,Ⓒadv.ⒹsAdaraM, sapraSrayaM, sabahu-mAnaM, AtiTeyasatkAreRa, satkAra-AtiTya-pUrvaM; ‘to receive h(ospitably)’ satkf 8 U, pUj 10, sa-BU c.
Hospitality,Ⓒs.ⒹAtiTyaM, AtiTyakarman n., atiTisatkAraH-pUjA-sevA-kriyA; satkAraH, satkriyA, satkfti f., upacAraH, pUjA, sevanaM.

Host,Ⓒs.ⒹgaRaH, saMGaH, samUhaH, oGaH, nivahaH; See Multitude.
Ⓑ
 2 camUH, senA, anIkaM, varUTinI.
Ⓑ
 3 gfhin m., BojanadAyin m., nimaMtraRakft, nimaMtrakaH, AtiTyakft.
Ⓝ[Host]age,Ⓒs.ⒹviSvAsasTAnaM, SarIrabaMDakaH; ‘retaining 4 hares as h(ostage)s’ caturaH SaSakAn viSvAsasTAne DftvA (P. i. 8).
Ⓝ[Host]ess,Ⓒs.ⒹgfhiRI, BojanadAtrI, AtiTyakAriRI.

Hostile,Ⓒa.Ⓓvipakza, virudDa, vErin, pratyarTin, pratikUla, viparIta, vidvezin, ahita, pratiro-Din ‘a h(ostile) invasion’ SatruvigrahaH, SatruyAnaM; ‘to be h(ostile)’ viruD 7 U, dviz 2 U; paryavasTA 1 A, pratikUlayati-vErAyate (D.), vipakzI-pratyarTI-BU.
Ⓝ[Hostile]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹSatruvat, vipakzavat.
Ⓝ[Hostil]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹvipakzatA, vEraM, SatrutA, vEraBAvaH, vi-roDaH, pratidvaMdvaM, vidvezaH; ‘in a state of constant h(ostility)’ sadAbadDavEra a.; ‘natural h(ostility)’ svaBAva-jAti-vEraM, SASvatikaH viroDaH.
Ⓑ
 2 vigrahaH, yudDaM, saMgrAmaH, yudDaBAvaH.
